content.text: The ELAC requires that you implement at least two High Impact Practices into your ELAC seminar course or one High Impact Practice into your ELAC disciplinary course.

content.placeholder: What High Impact Practices do you plan to implement in your course? Why do you think this high impact practice will best promote progress toward the learning outcomes for your course? If your course is not in the ELAC curriculum and is not conducive to implementation of a high impact practice skip to the question about teaching practices within your course below.

How will you approach embedding high impact practices in your course in a way that recognizes that previous exposure to the practices may be disproportionate based on race, class, and gender and engages students from diverse backgrounds?
What other teaching practices do you plan to use in your course? How do you expect students to work toward learning outcomes throughout the semester?
How can you teach with humility, acknowledging your own biases and challenging students to encounter their own?
Based on the information you compiled above, how would you describe the high impact practices and/or other teaching practices you are embedding in this course to your students?
